title: Tech Note: Web Services and 4D Internet Commands, the Amazon.com client

historical_commentary.text: Amazon's original SOAP-based web service used in this example has long been retired in favor of its modern REST/JSON Product Advertising API (with different authentication and request formats), making this note's specific integration code obsolete; it remains an interesting historical snapshot of how early e-commerce API integration looked in the SOAP era.
related_updates: Amazon's original SOAP-based web service has been retired and replaced by the modern REST/JSON-based Amazon Product Advertising API, which uses entirely different authentication and request formats
